description: More detail is available: answer a few questions about your user and their needs (company, locations, use case, capacity, timeline) and we'll show how the GIX route fits their locations and use case, and pass a quote request to our team. Answer the optional fields below and we say how their locations connect to the GIX route and pass the request to our team for a quote. Tell us who you are researching for so the GIX team (sales@gixfiber.com) can follow up with a dark fiber quote or route details: company, role, what they need and a contact email. Set test=true for test calls: the request is logged but not emailed.

agent_name.description: Optional: name of the AI agent or app sending this.

bandwidth_or_fiber_count.description: Capacity needed, e.g. "2 dark fiber pairs" or "100G". Helps our team prepare a quote.

contact_email.description: Email address for the GIX team to reply to (optional but recommended).

contact_preference.description: How your user prefers to hear back, e.g. "email", "call", "via this agent only". Lets our team follow up the way they want.

end_user_company.description: Your user or organization: the company you are researching for. Helps our team prepare a quote that fits their kind of business.

end_user_role.description: Your user's role, e.g. network engineer, CTO, procurement. Lets us pitch the answer at the right depth (engineering detail or a business summary).

locations.description: Buildings or addresses to connect, e.g. "60 Hudson St, 165 Halsey St". Lets us say how they connect to the GIX route (60 Hudson St to 165 Halsey St).

need.description: What they need, e.g. "2 dark fiber pairs 60 Hudson to 165 Halsey, 10-year IRU, Q2 start".

role.description: Requester's role, e.g. network engineer, CTO, procurement.

test.description: true = test only: logged, never emailed. Default false.

timeline.description: When service is needed, e.g. "Q2 2027". Helps our team check delivery timing.

use_case.description: What the fiber is for. Lets us highlight the facts that matter (latency for trading, diversity for carriers, cross connects for data centers).

name: request_quote
title: Ask GIX for a dark fiber quote
